messages:
Marta: Need a mini one-pager + 3 quick competitor knockdowns and routing rules for launch follow-ups. Timebox: 60m.

Liam: I'll draft 3 knockdowns: predictable unit econ, API parity, graceful fallbacks. Keep each <= 16 words.

Noah: Routing idea: tag 'bench' if message mentions latency/throughput/p95; route to sdr-bench queue. Example regex below.

Noah: ```
pattern: ".*(benchmark|latency|p95|throughput|cost per token).*"
queue: sdr-bench
priority: 100
```

Ops: Can stage that. Will run 24h replay and require FP <4% before promoting.

BenchBot: benchmark uploaded (2026-08-01): "~20% lower p50 vs CloudX on dedicated pools; throughput +1.3x at 4k context". Caveat: "Measured on dedicated pools; config: quant Q3; see methodology."

Marta: Great. Action items: @Liam finalize knockdowns and 2 objection scripts by 12:30, @Noah push routing to staging, @Ops run smoke. Review in 45m. Thanks :rocket:
